rationale_md: England enters this Group L clash as clear favorites, backed by a significant 100-point Elo rating advantage over Croatia that translates to roughly a 3-to-1 edge in their chances of avoiding defeat. The Three Lions' superior ranking reflects their deeper squad talent and recent competitive form, making them well-positioned to control proceedings at both ends of the pitch. Croatia will need to punch above their weight and capitalize on any English complacency to secure a result in what shapes up as an uphill battle for the 2018 runners-up.
